aboutpara: I'm a Senior Software Engineer on the Super Intelligence team at Microsoft AI, building AI capabilities across the Microsoft ecosystem—models for text, image, audio, and video. Previously, on Intercom's AI Agent Team, I shipped large-scale conversational AI infrastructure for chat, email, and voice, powering 30,000+ businesses with autonomous, context-aware agents backed by LLMs and robust backends. Before that, at respond.io, I led AI agent messaging infrastructure supporting 13 million daily conversations. I care about scalable systems, reliability, and products that meaningfully advance how people use AI.

resume.tagline: 👋 Building AI of the future at Microsoft AI.
resume.description: I'm a Senior Software Engineer on the Super Intelligence team at Microsoft AI, building AI capabilities across the Microsoft ecosystem—models for text, image, audio, and video. Previously, on Intercom's AI Agent Team, I shipped large-scale conversational AI infrastructure for chat, email, and voice, powering 30,000+ businesses. Before that, at respond.io, I led AI agent messaging infrastructure supporting 13 million daily conversations.

bullets: Building AI capabilities for the Microsoft ecosystem as part of the Microsoft AI Labs squad (Super Intelligence team).

Envisioning and bringing new ideas to life — transforming cutting-edge models (text, image, audio, video) into usable, real-world experiences through model adaptation, productisation, and broad adoption.
Bringing Microsoft AI models to millions of people globally.
As part of Intercom's AI Agent Team, helped build large-scale conversational AI infrastructure for chat, email, and voice automation — powering over 30,000 businesses worldwide.
Worked toward autonomous, context-aware agents that combine advanced LLMs with robust backend architecture to deliver reliable, human-like interactions.

Tech: Ruby on Rails, Golang, TypeScript, Ember, React, PlanetScale, AWS (Lambda, EC2, SQS, DynamoDB, ElasticSearch), Redis, Terraform, Datadog, Honeycomb, Sentry, Buildkite, Anthropic Claude, Cursor, Figma, RAG frameworks.
Led the development of AI agent messaging infrastructure supporting 13 million daily conversations across multiple communication channels.
Focused on delivering low-latency, reliable, and scalable backend systems for enterprise-level customer support AI agents.
Built distributed infrastructure enabling AI agents to handle 13M+ daily messages with high availability.
Optimized conversation workflows by refactoring core modules and server configurations — reducing response time from 700 ms to 100 ms and boosting user satisfaction by 30%.
Enhanced push notification systems through batching and delivery optimization, cutting average delivery time from 10 s to 2 s.
Collaborated with a cross-functional team of 15 engineers across global deployments.
Tech: Node.js, Golang, TypeScript, RDS, DynamoDB, Redis, SQS, Lambdas, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, Docker, Buildkite.
Entrepreneurial Resident at Antler (Singapore) — co-founded and built a financial AI application from the ground up.
Focused on problem discovery, rapid prototyping, and validating product-market fit in a fast-paced startup environment.
Nimblebot is a premier provider of design and development services for industry leaders and government organizations (PayPal, Coursera, MIT, GitHub, HBO, Saudi Tourism Authority, Al Futtaim).
Led the tech team as a product engineer; focused on creating products from a customer perspective.
Crafted scalable architectures and built robust systems for web and mobile applications.
Spearheaded the development of the Hyyp mobile application — a social impact network for web 3.0 users.

Mission 4 — Biotech research SaaS: streamlined data analysis processes, reducing project turnaround times by 40% and enabling researchers to manage 250+ active projects concurrently. Tech: Angular, C#, OData, Breeze, Jasmine, Azure DevOps. Used by hundreds of companies globally.
Mission 3 — SaaS security platform with integration support for HR data export. Tech: PHP, Symfony. Used by millions.
Mission 2 — Healthcare portal for families to track vitals, appointments and prescriptions. Tech: Vue.js, Jest, Node.js. Used by millions of families in Canada.
Mission 1 — Drag-and-drop form builder for doctors to create patient forms in hospitals. Tech: Vue.js, Node.js.
Co-founded and led engineering for a premier event-space booking marketplace in Pakistan. Archive lives at spacesly.online.
Architected the platform from scratch and scaled the engineering team through incubations at the National Incubation Center (NIC) and the National Science and Technology Park (NSTP).
Built, mentored and managed a 10-person cross-functional team across engineering, product design and QA — establishing agile workflows and CI/CD.
Supported the business to 10M+ PKR in revenue with 100+ customers and 50+ active venue listings.
Directed technical strategy until COVID-19 halted the live events industry; managed a calculated wind-down.
Co-founded and led a remote software development agency right out of university — scaled the team to 12 cross-functional members delivering engineering services to US-based clients.
Dual role as business executive and technical architect: managed client relationships, organizational growth and hands-on full-stack development.
Built scalable web applications using Node.js, Golang, and PHP; integrated Vue.js / Angular frontends; managed MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.
Deployed secure applications on AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda) using CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and OAuth 2.0 / JWT authentication.
